sections.heading: 1. Legal Foundation & Statutory Framework
sections.content:
Securing admission to prestigious institutions like Dhaka University, BUET, or Medical Colleges can instantly turn into a crisis if document verifications uncover discrepancies on SSC or HSC certificates. While education board corrections require 30 to 60 days, university deadlines span only days. A legally structured Court Undertaking Affidavit before a 1st Class Magistrate provides provisional enrollment immunity.

Under the statutory framework of the Ministry of Education and Judicial Regulations in Bangladesh, administrative rectifications and affidavits are legally enforceable instruments to resolve credential discrepancies.

sections.heading: 2. Necessity of 1st Class Magistrate Court Affidavit
sections.content: For all regulatory, visa, and education board purposes, affidavits sworn before a 1st Class Judicial Magistrate carry absolute legal evidentiary value, far exceeding standard Notary Public attestations. These are executed on 300 BDT non-judicial stamp paper in open court.

sections.heading: 3. Step-by-Step Practical Application Procedure
sections.content:
To prevent admission forfeiture due to certificate discrepancies, candidates must submit a formal Court Undertaking Affidavit sworn before a 1st Class Magistrate on 300 BDT stamp paper, legally guaranteeing that amended credentials will be produced within a stipulated timeframe.

  1. Consult qualified advocate for precise legal drafting.
  2. Execution before the 1st Class Judicial Magistrate bench.
  3. Submission of certified affidavit along with supporting credentials to relevant authorities.
  4. Issuance of corrected certificates or official clearance orders.

sections.heading: 4. Required Documentation & Official Fees 2026
sections.content: Applicants require original academic transcripts, bilingual digital birth certificates, verified parent National Identity Cards, and valid Passports. Statutory expenses include 300 BDT non-judicial stamp duty and prescribed institutional fees.

sections.heading: 5. Legal Assistance from Supreme Court Advocate
sections.content: Advocate Md. Shah Alam is an enrolled Supreme Court lawyer and Assistant Public Prosecutor. For expedited Magistrate Affidavits, board liaison, and international authentication services, visit our Uttara or Dhaka Judge Court chambers.

faqs.q: How can I schedule a chamber consultation for credential affidavits?
faqs.a: You can visit our Uttara Chamber (House 46, Road 6/B, Sector 12) between 7:00 PM and 10:00 PM, or Dhaka Judge Court Chamber between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM upon confirming appointment via WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How long does court affidavit execution take?
faqs.a: Our chamber typically completes drafting and 1st Class Judicial Magistrate bench execution within 1 business day.
